item.title: The President held a meeting of the Military-Industrial Commission of the Russian Federation
item.description: The President held a meeting of the Military-Industrial Commission of the Russian Federation Today, we will talk about the new draft State Armament Programme and the defense and industrial complex development programme. They will become the backbone for designing and serial production of modern weapons systems and hardware for our army and other defence and law enforcement agencies for them to be ready for a rapid and effective response to potential external threats. And, as is known, these threats are not diminishing.

item.title: Ahead of Gunsmith Day, Vladimir Putin presented state decorations to workers of Russia’s defence industry and congratulated them on their professional holiday
item.description: Ahead of Gunsmith Day, Vladimir Putin presented state decorations to workers of Russia’s defence industry and congratulated them on their professional holiday I would like to thank Russian weapons producers for their proactivity and innovations, and for their earnest, intensive and sometimes, without exaggeration, truly heroic efforts. You skillfully and promptly resolve complex and unconventional challenges, actively modernise manufacturing, and work multiple shifts and overtime. You also regularly visit the frontline to study the performance of your products in combat conditions and use this experience to improve their capabilities.

item.title: 🔥 We can bring the house down, or slip through the eye of a needle Russian troops obliterated a temporary deployment area
item.description: We can bring the house down, or slip through the eye of a needle 🔥 Russian troops obliterated a temporary deployment area of the 15th Separate National Guard Brigade of the AFU by FAB-500 aerial bombs in Bokovoye (Donetsk People's Republic). 💥 Kh-39 lightweight guided missiles were launched at an AFU UAV control post of the 13th Separate National Guard Brigade in Liptsy (Kharkov region). 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued delivering strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against Ukrainian ports and ships
item.description: ❗️ During the day, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued delivering strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against Ukrainian ports and ships used in the interests of the AFU. 🔥 As a result of the strikes, the following targets were hit : ▫️ in the port of Yuzhny (Odessa region) – a dry cargo ship that had delivered military-purpose cargo; ▫️ in the port of Odessa – a tanker that had delivered fuel and lubricants for the AFU. 💥 In addition, a dry cargo ship carrying cargo intended to support the AFU to the port of Odessa was hit at sea crossing. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
